decision.rationale: The disputed charge is TXN-007894. It is on card CRD-000082 at Copperleaf Gym (MER-000009), which bills on a recurring basis. The charge was made on 2026-09-19, posted on 2026-09-20 and is for 6778 minor units (67.78 EUR), the same as the amount claimed. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 39 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone and has nothing in writing. No documents are attached, so there is no merchant-issued cancellation confirmation and no effective date to compare with the charge date. Under recurring-no-proof, the merchant must provide its cancellation records and the terms for the subscription.

proposed_actions.note: For the subscription charge of 67.78 EUR made on 2026-09-19, please provide your cancellation records for this cardholder's membership, including any record of a cancellation request made by phone and its date, and the cancellation terms that applied to the subscription.
